overview_description.description:
99 minutos is a last-mile logistics disruptor for LatAm's burgeoning e-commerce space. The company enables enterprise e-commerce clients to reliably same-day deliver products at low cost - a first for the region. Currently operating in Mexico, Chile, Colombia, and Peru.

The company was founded in 2014 by Alexis Patjane and is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.

product.name: E-commerce Delivery Service
product.description: A delivery service for e-commerce businesses operating in Latin America, providing parcel shipping across more than 60 cities using own fleet and partner networks.

product.name: Logistics Platform for Shipment Management
product.description: A logistics platform that enables e-commerce businesses to manage customer data, shipments, reports, and automate logistics operations.

product.name: Warehousing and Storage Services
product.description: Storage and warehousing services integrated with e-commerce logistics to support inventory management and order fulfillment.

product.name: Cash on Delivery Collection Service
product.description: A service that manages payment collection upon delivery for e-commerce shipments, integrated within the logistics process.
